question: The HCF of two numbers is 17 and the other two factors of their LCM are 11 and 19. The smaller of the two numbers is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Numbers are obtained by multiplying their HCF with the co-prime factors of their LCM.

Given HCF = 17 and the other two factors of LCM are 11 and 19.

Smaller Number = HCF × Smaller factor

Smaller Number = 17 × 11 = 187

**∴ The correct answer is 187.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

HCF of two numbers = 17

Other two factors of their LCM = 11 and 19

**Formula Used:**

If HCF of two numbers is H, then the numbers can be expressed as Hx and Hy, where x and y are co-prime factors.

LCM of these numbers = Hxy

 
 HCF = 17
 
• 
 × 11
 
 Smaller Number
 17 × 11 = 187
 
• 
 × 19
 
 Larger Number
 17 × 19 = 323
 Result: Smaller Number = 187

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the two numbers be 17x and 17y.

⇒ LCM = 17xy

⇒ It is given that the factors of the LCM (other than the HCF) are 11 and 19.

⇒ So, the values are x = 11 and y = 19.

⇒ First number = 17 × 11 = 187

⇒ Second number = 17 × 19 = 323

⇒ Therefore, the smaller number is 187.

**∴ The correct answer is 187.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relation between HCF and LCM

The product of two given numbers is always exactly equal to the product of their HCF and LCM. Formula: Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM

Co-prime Factors

When we divide the LCM of two numbers by their HCF, the resulting quotient gives the product of two co-prime factors. These specific factors multiply individually with the HCF to yield the original two numbers.
